when.test: noticeQueryVO.noticeType != null and noticeQueryVO.noticeType != '' and noticeQueryVO.noticeType == 'system'

choose.when: SELECT count(1) FROM tb_user_notice WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND notice_type = #{noticeQueryVO.noticeType}

mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, notice_type AS noticeType, source_id AS sourceId, source_type AS sourceType, target_id AS targetId, target_type AS targetType, jump_path AS jumpPath, anchor_key AS anchorKey, content, CASE WHEN notice_type IN ('comment_reply', 'talk_reply') THEN reply_content ELSE NULL END AS replyContent, is_read AS isRead, create_time AS createTime FROM tb_user_notice WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{noticeId} LIMIT 1
